title: Math Sprint
summary: Race the clock with mental maths — from counting on and times tables to percentages, squares, negatives and BODMAS — with a strategy tip after every answer.

title: Spell Bee
summary: Hear a word, read its meaning and an example sentence, then spell it — with memory tricks and spelling rules for every word.

title: Quiz Show
summary: A game-show quiz across science, India, the world, maths and language — climb the prize ladder with 50:50, hint and audience-poll lifelines, and learn why each answer is right.

title: Memory Match
summary: Flip cards to find matching pairs — same pictures for little ones, animals and their babies for kids, and chemical elements with their symbols for older learners.

title: Word Builder
summary: Build words three ways: sound out picture words letter by letter, find hidden words in a set of letters, and assemble prefixes, roots and suffixes to make words that match a meaning.

title: Bubble Pop ABC
summary: Pop floating bubbles to learn the alphabet: match big letters, then small letters, then the first sound of a picture word — with gentle, no-fail feedback.

title: Number Line Jump
summary: Help a frog hop along a number line to place numbers, add and subtract by jumping, cross zero into negatives, and land on fractions and decimals.

title: Flag Dash
summary: Race against the clock to name 40+ national flags drawn in true colours, spot look-alikes such as Chad and Romania, and learn capitals and flag facts.

title: Market Day
summary: Run a nimbu-pani stall: give correct change in rupees, then set prices using a live demand and profit graph — learn revenue, cost, profit, break-even, margin vs markup and why limited stock changes the best price.

title: Rhythm Tap
summary: Tap in time with a precise metronome: steady pulse, eighth notes, rests, syncopation and Teentaal claps — with millisecond timing feedback, an early/late histogram and a tap-tempo steadiness meter.
